description:
Salad turns downtime into downloads. Run Salad whenever you're away from the keys to score games, gift cards, subscriptions, DLC, and more at the Salad Storefront.


Fixes an issue in 1.9.28 where Salad could delete and rebuild the container environment, clearing all cached container images, each time it started.
Fixes a "WSL Update Needed" notification after restarting a PC, when Salad started before you signed in to Windows.
General maintenance and reliability improvements.
